patterns: tell me about government college dharamshala
intents.response: Government College Dharamshala became an intermediate college in 1926, a degree college in 1947 and introduced postgraduate education in 1977. It received NAAC B++ accreditation in 2022. Source: https://gcdharamshala.in/about-us/
Government College Dharamshala is in Dharamshala, Kangra district, Himachal Pradesh. See https://gcdharamshala.in/
Find the current official college contact details at https://gcdharamshala.in/

patterns: which university is college affiliated with
intents.response: The college lists regular and several self-financing programmes under Himachal Pradesh University (HPU), while MBA, MCA and B.Tech are listed under Himachal Pradesh Technical University (HPTU). Check the programme prospectus: https://gcdharamshala.in/download/

Courses listed by the college include BA, BSc, BCom, BBA, BCA, BSc Biotechnology, B.Tech (CSE), B.Voc (Retail Management and Hospitality & Tourism), PGDCA, MA, MSc, MCom, MBA and MCA. Check current admission availability at https://admission.gcdharamshala.in/
Undergraduate offerings include BA, BSc, BCom, BBA, BCA, BSc Biotechnology, B.Tech (CSE) and B.Voc programmes. See https://gcdharamshala.in/ug-courses/
Postgraduate offerings listed include MA, MSc, MCom, MBA and MCA. PGDCA is a postgraduate diploma. See https://admission.gcdharamshala.in/

patterns: how to apply for college admission
intents.response: Use the official admission portal https://admission.gcdharamshala.in/ and choose the UG/PG general or professional programme category. Complete registration and follow the programme-specific counselling instructions.
Admission dates vary by programme and session. Read current announcements at https://admission.gcdharamshala.in/ and https://gcdharamshala.in/all-post/.

The official portal asks applicants to prepare Aadhaar/enrolment number, qualifying marks card, mobile number, email, university registration number if applicable and valid category documents if relevant. Check counselling instructions: https://admission.gcdharamshala.in/
Check the applicant login, merit lists and counselling notices at https://admission.gcdharamshala.in/ and https://gcdharamshala.in/all-post/. This chatbot cannot view personal application status.
Fee amounts vary by programme, category and session. Read the latest official course prospectus at https://gcdharamshala.in/download/; CampusMind does not guess fees.
Use only the instructions provided by the official admission or student portal: https://admission.gcdharamshala.in/
For scholarship schemes, eligibility and application dates, consult official college notices and the student support office: https://gcdharamshala.in/
The college maintains programme-wise syllabus links for Arts, Science, Commerce, Management, Computer Science, B.Voc and PG courses: https://gcdharamshala.in/syllabus-2/
Examination dates depend on the programme and affiliating university. Check official college notices and the relevant university examination portal.
Check the results service of your programme’s affiliating university. CampusMind cannot retrieve private marks or results.
Attendance requirements depend on the current prospectus and applicable university regulations. Check with your department for the official rule.
The college reports a computerized library with more than 71,000 books and electronic resources. See https://gcdharamshala.in/about-library/
Check the latest library timings on the official library page: https://gcdharamshala.in/about-library/
The college publishes hostel forms and hostel prospectuses. Consult https://gcdharamshala.in/download/ for the current session.
Hostel charges are specified in the current hostel prospectus: https://gcdharamshala.in/download/.
The college has department-specific classrooms and laboratory facilities. See https://gcdharamshala.in/class-rooms-and-seminar-halls/ and ask the relevant department for access details.
College sports activities and selection-trial notices are posted on https://gcdharamshala.in/all-post/.
For current career guidance, placement activities and internships, check official college notices and contact the relevant department: https://gcdharamshala.in/
Use the official student/applicant portal at https://admission.gcdharamshala.in/. Do not share passwords or verification codes in chat.
Current notices, merit lists and academic announcements are published at https://gcdharamshala.in/all-post/ and https://admission.gcdharamshala.in/
